output.summary: KEP-2411 graduated the CRIContainerLogRotation feature gate from Beta to Stable, so the kubelet manages container log directory structure and rotates container logs by size and file count. Its status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: The feature had been in production use since v1.10 and Beta since v1.11, and the KEP aimed to identify and close gaps before promoting it to stable. The kubelet already chooses the log path and passes it to the runtime, so it is the natural component to rotate logs. Reviewers discussed open gaps (lost logs during rotation, kubectl logs support, dockershim flag handling) and the KEP was approved for the v1.21 milestone.

alternatives.option: Proposal to add a log-specific metric for container log usage
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer derekwaynecarr argued against it, noting log usage is charged to per-container ephemeral storage and already handled by the eviction manager.

alternatives.option: Include kubectl logs rotation support (kubernetes/kubernetes#59902) as a graduation requirement
alternatives.why_not: derekwaynecarr argued against including it, citing kubelet skew challenges that could be handled as a separate follow-on feature; the thread ultimately reached consensus to move forward.

alternatives.option: Have kubelet fail to start when rotation flags are set alongside dockershim
alternatives.why_not: derekwaynecarr noted the flags are documented as only usable with a remote runtime, and failing would require changing defaulting logic that has no clear precedent.

evidence.quote: The CRIContainerLogRotation feature gate was implemented in v1.10 and has been in Beta stage since v1.11.
Graduate the CRIContainerLogRotation feature gate from Beta to Stable.
GKE already used CRIContainerLogRotation long time ago, and there is no compatibility issue.
The kubelet cannot fail with these set without changing the defaulting logic for these fields to only default when runtime is remote.
